# Standing Rules

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Protect deep-work blocks:** Tuesday and Thursday mornings are maker time — don't schedule over
  them; push status meetings elsewhere.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Keep the Tuesday 11:00 with [Sofia Alvarez](../people/sofia-alvarez.md)** even though it lands
  near deep-work — reliability optics with revenue matter right now.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Never send outward without explicit OK** — draft emails and calendar invites; don't send.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Falcon discipline:** use the code name only; never write the real name outside the registry;
  never loop in anyone outside the cleared circle.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Reliability first:** when Ledger (cost) and Meridian (reliability) conflict, reliability wins.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly to Sofia:** send [Meridian](../projects/meridian.md) status every week while at risk.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **No Friday production deploys** — reflect this when planning launches.
